<div class="card-body">
'''2X-3KPR (Tooex)''' is the Japanese-language [[Premiere (Japanese)]] printing of [[2X-3KPR (Tooex)]].<ref name="encyclopedia">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41 and 97 (index 3876). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>


<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">2X-3KPR（トゥエックス）</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">「夜間状態」の場合、同じ場所の自分の反乱軍、エイリアンは、すべて戦闘力が＋２される。「水耕ステーション」のカードと同じ場所にあると、さらに耐：損耗＜３を得る。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-2x-3kpr-tooex-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">整備点検用の単純作業ドロイド。各所に配備された警戒センサーや非常灯、電磁フェンスなどを遠隔起動させる。レリモア・ドロイズ社製のサーバント・ドロイド。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' 2X-3KPR (Tooex).

'''Card text:''' During night conditions, all your Rebels and aliens at the same location are power +2. At the same location as [[Hydroponics Station|Hydroponics Station]], it also gains immunity to attrition less than 3.

'''Lore:''' A simple labor droid used for maintenance and inspection. It remotely activates warning sensors, emergency lights, electromagnetic fences, and similar equipment installed throughout an area. A servant droid manufactured by Lerrimore Droids.
